title: Craft templates
description: Now you don't need to explore the world in search of a template; all you need is the right items and a workbench!
body:
**Would you like to create the necessary templates at home?** No problem, with this datapack, you can create armor templates right at the home without wasting any time! But it's not that easy, you still need to obtain the necessary auxiliary blocks and a lot of diamonds. But this won't stop a professional player!
